title: Average over outgoing neighbors
statement: Let $G$ be a finite directed graph, $f$ a rational-valued function on its vertices, and $v$ a vertex. Define the outgoing average of $f$ at $v$ as the arithmetic mean of $f$ over the outgoing neighbors of $v$ when there is at least one; when there are none, define it to be $f(v)$.
hypotheses_covered: A rational-valued function f on its vertices
